method.regret: Bench regret = best possible lineup from that week's roster minus points scored (Sleeper's max PF method).
method.moves: Missed moves pair each bench player who belonged in the best lineup with the lowest-scoring starter he could have replaced.
method.allplay: All-play = record if a team played every other team every week.
method.luck: Luck = actual wins minus expected wins from all-play (win share each week, summed).
